Contract:
**Compact AI-to-AI inline format.** Ephemeral read-only output at session end. One header line + one line per finding. No markdown tables, decorative text, or applied-change records.
Grammar (one logical record per line, EOL-terminated; fields separated by ` | `):
``` @audit task= round= mode= status= counts=B·M·m·I phases_to_fix=[<P|Task-ID:P>,...] F- | sev= | type= | conf= | loc= | phase=<P|—> | src= | route= | act= F- | … @glossary suggestions=[] ```
Token vocabulary: - `sev`: `B`=BLOCKER, `M`=MAJOR, `m`=MINOR, `I`=INFO. - `conf`: `H`=HIGH, `M`=MEDIUM, `L`=LOW. - `type`: one of `CLOSED_WORLD_DRIFT` | `COMPLETENESS_GAP` | `RUNTIME_BACKING_VIOLATION` | `RULES_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION` | `RULES_CASCADE_MISMATCH` | `TASK_ID_DRIFT` | `BDD_COVERAGE_MISMATCH` | `EXECUTION_LOG_INCOMPLETE` | `STALE_AFTER_PIVOT` | `INSIGHT_BACKFLOW` | `RULE_FILE_INCOMPLETE` | `LANGUAGE_QUALITY` | `YAGNI_WAIVER_INCOMPLETE` | `ENVIRONMENT_GATE_UNAVAILABLE` | `DEAD_CODE_SUSPECT`. - `route`: one of `spec-edit` | `ticket-reopen` | `ticket-update` | `decision-log` | `code-fix` | `operator-escalation` | `new-task` (per `AX_FINDING_ROUTING`). - `act` text: Russian operator-facing per `AX_OPERATOR_LANGUAGE` (this is operator-facing artifact text), single line, no pipe character. - `status` `PASS_RISK` = PASS_WITH_ACKNOWLEDGED_RISKS. - `mode=per-group` (default, auto-dispatch, `AX_AUDIT_MODES`): `task` carries the group's spec path, not a single Task-ID; `phases_to_fix` entries carry the owning Task-ID prefix (`Task-ID:P`) since a finding may name a phase on any ticket in the group. `mode=per-task` (operator-manual): `task` carries the single audited Task-ID; `phases_to_fix` entries are bare `P` (that ticket is implicit).
Example: ``` @audit task=TSK-04 round=3 mode=per-task status=FAIL counts=B1·M2·m0·I1 phases_to_fix=[P2,P3] F-01 | sev=B | type=CLOSED_WORLD_DRIFT | conf=H | loc=src/payments/adapter.ts:42 | phase=P2 | src=specs/backend/payments/payments.spec.md#2 | route=spec-edit | act=добавить `IdempotencyKey` в Entity Inventory модуля payments F-02 | sev=M | type=RULES_COMPLIANCE_VIOLATION | conf=H | loc=src/payments/adapter.ts:100 | phase=P2 | src=ai/directives/coding/typescript-rules.xml#AX_STRICT_NULL | route=ticket-reopen | act=добавить null-guard на response.balanceTransaction F-03 | sev=M | type=BDD_COVERAGE_MISMATCH | conf=H | loc=src/payments/adapter.test.ts:55 | phase=P3 | src=specs/backend/payments/payments.task.PAY-adapter.md#4 | route=ticket-update | act=переименовать тест-кейс в `should reject non-positive amount with InvalidAmountError` F-04 | sev=I | type=INSIGHT_BACKFLOW | conf=M | loc=src/payments/adapter.ts:88 | phase=— | src=specs/backend/payments/payments.spec.md#4 | route=spec-edit | act=зафиксировать retry-budget в DbC postcondition @glossary suggestions=[] ```
Rules: - First line MUST be the `@audit` header. No free-text preamble. - Findings ordered by descending severity, then by `F-NN`; the final `@glossary` line is mandatory (`[]` or `[ — ; ...]`). Audit/code-review workers only propose terminology there; the owning specification remains the source of truth. - No empty lines inside the block. - If `loc` or `src` is N/A, emit literal `—` (em-dash) — do not omit the field. - `act` is operator-facing text (Russian per policy); everything else is English tokens.
